dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Continuous, symmetrical geometric narrowing from the wide mid-section toward a narrow, pointed posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth, convex lateral margins without localized asymmetrical bulges or indentations where the skin meets the water.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity median pixel reflectance across the entire visible dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: One prominent, high-contrast dark circular mark on the dorsal cranial region with internal shadowing indicating depth.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Visible topological depression on the central axis of the head corresponding with a localized dark lesion.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep, circular localized trauma or puncture-style lesion on the dorsal head region, exhibiting dark internal contrast and shadow-casting.
